---
title: "Artifacts and sources"
---

## Canonical manifests

- `manifests/sources.yaml` — versioned papers and official repositories.
- `manifests/models.yaml` — released model identities and revisions; no local weights.
- `manifests/datasets.yaml` — audited dataset identities, revisions, and known/unknown
  content hashes for the locked SiRA protocol.
- `manifests/artifacts.yaml` — generated artifact identities; currently empty because
  no experiment has run.
- `manifests/compute.yaml` — zero-use ledger through Phase 0.75; no model, benchmark,
  training, cloud, or paid-compute execution has occurred.

Large artifacts will be hosted outside Git and addressed by stable URI plus SHA-256
when a hash is known. Unknown hashes remain explicit rather than inferred. This site
will expose reviewed summaries and immutable links rather than embedding checkpoints,
raw traces, or bulk media.
